title: Files from vaults leak names in apps' non-encrypted "recent items" lists
line: Locking a vault now removes its files from recent-file lists, the launcher's History and task manager jump lists.
explanation: Apps record opened files in recently-used.xbel and in kactivitymanagerd's stats like any other file, and nothing removed vault paths when the vault was locked, so Kickoff History, Recent Files and jump lists kept showing their names and paths. Deleting the stats was also not reliable: if a score update for the file was still queued (for example when the editor had just closed), kactivitymanagerd recreated the entry a second later. Now plasma-vault's kded removes every recently-used.xbel bookmark under the mount point and asks kactivitymanagerd to delete the stats for '<mountpoint>/*' whenever a vault reaches the Closed state (also on kded start, for vaults left over from a previous session), and kactivitymanagerd drops queued score updates for resources whose stats were deleted.

commits.message:
kded: Forget recent files from a vault when it is locked

Files opened from a vault stayed in recently-used.xbel and in the
activity stats after locking, so their names and paths kept showing in
launchers and jump lists. Remove those entries whenever a vault closes.

BUG: 444393

sqlite: Don't bring back scores of resources that were just forgotten

When stats were deleted while a score update for the same resource was
still queued, the update ran right after and recreated the cache entry,
so the forgotten file came back in recent lists. Drop such queued updates.

BUG: 444393

media.caption: Vault 'Priv' locked: Kickoff > Places > History still lists secret-notes.txt in Home/Vaults/Priv
Same steps with the fix: after locking, the vault file is gone from History; other entries stay

review.text: Purging recently-used.xbel and activity stats when a vault closes, plus cancelling queued score updates in kactivitymanagerd so a Forget can't be undone, addresses the leak and the race properly. But the kded parses recently-used.xbel by hand, duplicating KIO's file format knowledge, when KRecentDocument already offers the list.
changes: Use KRecentDocument::recentUrls() to find the bookmarks under the mount point instead of reading the XBEL with QXmlStreamReader (or add a KRecentDocument::removeFilesInDirectory() to KIO and call that).
